name: Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026
short_description: A full-marathon event in Surabaya, Indonesia, taking place October 4, 2026, with 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for October 4, 2026, in Surabaya, Indonesia. Runners can choose from four distances: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of experience levels. The race village, start and finish are at Balai Kota (City Hall) Surabaya, and race packs are collected at Mal Ciputra World on 2-3 October.
pros: Big field of nearly 9,000 runners with the city government behind it
Heavy medical cover, including cardiologists, ambulances and a mini ICU
Early 4am marathon start and a six-hour marathon cut-off
Small marathon field: third place in 2025 was 3:13:22 for men and 3:40:50 for women
cons: Hot and humid: 27°C and a 26°C dew point at the 4am start, 33°C by the marathon cut-off
Only the streets around City Hall are fully closed; some sections carry limited traffic
2026 entry open only to Indonesian citizens
A tight first marathon checkpoint: 10.7 km in 90 minutes

excerpt_quotes.quote: Kami mengirimkan imbauan kepada peserta lewat email dan media sosial agar tetap menjaga hidrasi, mengenali gejala heat stroke, dan tidak memaksakan diri di tengah cuaca panas
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Didit Santoso, Race Director, quoted in Tabloidbintang.com coverage of the 2025 edition

research_highlights: The marathon route is designed to pass Surabaya's historic landmarks including Tugu Pahlawan, Jembatan Merah, Balai Kota, Hotel Majapahit, and Museum Siola, per the 2025 edition's course description.
Cut-off times for 2026: Full Marathon 6 hours, Half Marathon 3.5 hours, 10K 2.5 hours, 5K 1.5 hours.
Flag-off times are early morning to beat the heat: Full Marathon 04:00 WIB, Half Marathon 04:30 WIB, 10K 05:00 WIB, 5K 05:20 WIB.
Race village/start-finish hub is at Balai Kota (City Hall) Surabaya, with race pack collection held separately at Mal Ciputra World on Oct 2-3, 2026.
For the 2025 edition organizers emphasized elevated medical staffing including cardiologists, anesthesiologists, ambulances and a mobile mini-ICU due to heat and endurance risks.
research_watchouts: Organizers explicitly warned 2025 participants about heat and heat-stroke risk, advising strict hydration and not overexerting in hot conditions.
The event was held as the ISOPLUS Run Surabaya in 2024 and added a full marathon for the first time in 2025, so the marathon has a short track record.

Most available commentary so far comes from official press releases and organizer-curated testimonials rather than independent runner reviews, so course/crowd-support details beyond the official narrative are hard to verify.

faqs.question: When is the Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026 takes place on Sunday 4 October 2026. The official rules give flag-off times of 4.00am for the marathon, 4.30am for the half marathon, 5.00am for the 10 km and 5.20am for the 5 km, with race packs collected at Mal Ciputra World on 2-3 October.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance options for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This range allows runners of varying experience and fitness levels to select a suitable distance.

faqs.question: Where exactly will the Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026 be held?
faqs.answer: The race village, start and finish are at Balai Kota, Surabaya's City Hall, according to the official 2026 rules. Race packs are collected beforehand at Mal Ciputra World in Surabaya on 2-3 October 2026, and runners must be at the start line 30 minutes before their category's flag-off.
